initializerNote: The owner-held protocol deployer key, used for initialize only through the owner's sign queue. It is the INITIALIZER constant in the contract; a unit test asserts the two are equal and equal to the deployer in deployments/arc-mainnet.json. If the key is lost, no new chain can be initialized at this address and chains already initialized are unaffected.

importCeilings.rule: importIdCeiling for each chain is the nextId recorded here, snapshotted at the recorded block, not a fresh read at initialize time. Take the snapshot before that chain's deploy is announced or the registry address is published, record it here, and pass exactly this nextId to initialize. A chain with no recorded snapshot is initialized with no outside registry (zero ceiling, no import window). A placeholder entry (placeholder: true) blocks the deploy preflight: node scripts/registry-deploy-preflight.mjs.

reproduce: The address is a function of the exact creation code, so it holds only for this source built with solc 0.8.26, via_ir, optimizer_runs 800, evm_version cancun, bytecode_hash none, cbor_metadata false (the repo's contracts/foundry.toml). From contracts/: forge build; node -e "process.stdout.write(require('./out/RWAllyAgentRegistry.sol/RWAllyAgentRegistry.json').bytecode.object)" | xargs cast keccak gives initcodeHash; cast create2 --deployer <factory> --salt <salt> --init-code-hash <initcodeHash> gives address. The unit test RWAllyAgentRegistryCreate2Test fails if either value drifts from the build.
